verdict.rationale: Fathom's own marketing documents a bot-free capture mode alongside bot capture and claims unlimited transcriptions, which covers the core of the story. However, the bot-free mode is labelled beta, and nothing documents how audio is captured from the device or what external participants see. Missing for 10: documentation of local/device audio capture, confirmation that participants see no indicator, GA status beyond beta, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can capture and transcribe meetings without a visible bot joining the call — audio is captured from my device so external participants see nothing extra

citations.quote: Choice of bot-free (in beta) or bot capture
Capture notes your way – bot or no bot – so you can stay focused on the meeting
